import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
an_date = '2025-10-20'
base_mask = (df['date'] >= '2025-10-13') & (df['date'] < an_date)
base = df[base_mask]
anom = df[df['date'] == an_date]
base_days = base['date'].nunique()
total_base = base['unblended_cost'].sum()/base_days
total_anom = anom['unblended_cost'].sum()
print(f"baseline avg/day: {total_base:.2f}, anomaly: {total_anom:.2f}, diff: {total_anom-total_base:.2f}")
for col in ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family','expiration_date']:
    b = base.groupby(col)['unblended_cost'].sum()/base_days
    a = anom.groupby(col)['unblended_cost'].sum()
    comp = pd.concat([b.rename('base'), a.rename('anom')], axis=1).fillna(0)
    comp['diff'] = comp['anom'] - comp['base']
    comp = comp.sort_values('diff', key=abs, ascending=False)
    print(f"\n=== {col} ===")
    print(comp.head(10).round(2).to_string())
    print("sum abs diff:", comp['diff'].abs().sum().round(2), " explained by top:")
    print("sum signed diff:", comp['diff'].sum().round(2))
